rules.name: Flame of the East
rules.description:
Height 1 only
Flaming Attacks, Volcanic Embrace (D3+1).

rules.name: Eye of the Bull
rules.description:
Affects both Shooting and Standard Melee Attacks. 
 Attack Value is always 1, Strength always 5, and Armour Penetration always 10.
 Automatic Hits, Multiple Wounds (2, Melee).

rules.name: Onyx Core
rules.description: Strength always 6; Flaming Attacks, Multiple Wounds (D3, towards Weakness (Flaming Attacks)).

rules.name: Banner of the Twice-Branded
rules.description: Models in the bearer's unit gain Shoot in Extra Rank.

rules.name: Their Master's Banner
rules.description:
Apply the following effects while the bearer’s unit is within range of a friendly model’s Commanding Presence: 
 • Model parts with Vassal in the bearer’s unit gain Fury. 
 • The bearer’s unit must reroll failed Charge Range rolls in the Charge Phase.

rules.name: Banner of Shamut
rules.description:
Models in the bearer’s unit gain +1 Off. 
In addition, a unit containing a Banner of Shamut adds +1 to the Combat Score of its side.

rules.name: Blaze of Protection
rules.description:
Height 1-2 only
The bearer’s Armour value is set to 6. 
At the end of Agility Step 0, each enemy model in contact with the bearer’s model that could have allocated attacks towards it, but chose not to, suffers one hit with Str 4, AP 0, Magical Attacks, Flaming Attacks, Unmodifiable.

rules.name: Kadim Binding
rules.description:
Height 1-4 only
Aegis (+1, against Flaming Attacks, max. 3+), Hand-and-a-Half.

rules.name: Breath of the Brass Bull
rules.description:
Height 1-4 only
The bearer’s model gains +1 HP and First Strike (Grind Attack (X, Magical Attacks, Toxic Attacks)). 
 X is equal to the number of models in contact with the bearer’s unit’s Front Facing.

rules.name: Golden Idol of Shamut
rules.description:
The bearer can cast Flaming Swords (Pyromancy) as a Bound Spell (4+). 
In addition, if the bearer’s model is of Height 1, its Charge Speed is set to 4", its Mobility is set to 6", and it gains Ghost Step.

rules.name: Mask of Ages
rules.description:
Height 1 only
The wearer gains Aegis (5+, against Grind Attack, Impact Hits, Magical Attacks, Stomp Attack), Terror, Hatred.

rules.name: Lugar's Dice
rules.description:
A single model part of the bearer’s model can reroll a single failed to-hit, to-wound, or Armour Save roll per Player Turn. 
This cannot be used for Crush Attacks.

rules.name: Ring of Desiccation
rules.description: During Combat Choices, each enemy unit in contact with the wearer’s model gains an Incendiary Marker.

rules.name: Tablet of Vezodinezh
rules.description: When the bearer attempts to cast a Learned Spell using four or more Magic Dice, treat a single rolled ‘1’ or ‘2’ as a ‘3’.

sharedRules.name: Keys to the Citadel
sharedRules.description:
The model must buy Weapon Enchantments for two of its mundane weapons. 
The Points Cost of one of the Weapon Enchantments (the cheapest if applicable) is halved, rounding fractions up.

sharedRules.name: Prophet of Ashuruk
sharedRules.description:
During Pre-game Selections, regardless of its chosen Path of Magic, the model may exchange one of its spells for the Apprentice Spell (#1) of either Alchemy, Pyromancy, Occultism. 
 In addition, it gains access to the options below:

sharedRules.name: Prophet of Lugar
sharedRules.description:
The model gains Aegis (4+), Aegis (3+, against Flaming Attacks), suffers -3 Arm, and loses Metal Armour and Infernal Armour. 
 The model part gains Flaming Attacks,Magical Attacks. 
In addition, the model gains access to the options below:

sharedRules.name: Prophet of Nezibkesh
sharedRules.description:
The model gains Engineer (Gunnery Team, Infernal Artillery or Infernal Engine). 
In addition, it gains access to the options below:

sharedRules.name: Prophet of Shamut
sharedRules.description: The model gains access to the options below:

sharedRules.name: Unbranded
sharedRules.description: The model cannot take any Army Specific Magic Items, and can never cast Curse of Nezibkesh.

sharedRules.name: Riddle of the Lamassu
sharedRules.description:
During the opponent’s Pre-game Selections, the opponent must choose Power or Wisdom. 
 • Power: the model gains Channel (1). 
 • Wisdom: immediately choose up to two units from the opponent’s Army List: the chosen units begin the game with an Incendiary Marker.

sharedRules.name: Vassal Governor
sharedRules.description: Friendly units entirely with Vassal within 12" of one or more models with Vassal Governor gain +1" Mobility.

sharedRules.name: Firing Platform
sharedRules.description:
Shooting Attacks against the model’s unit are all resolved against the Infernal Bastion. 
In addition, as long as the unit has at least one Proper Rank, apply the following to all models in the Infernal Bastion's unit when they are shooting or casting spells: 
 • May draw Line of Sight as if they were Height 5, and from any point of the Infernal Bastion’s Front Facing. 
 • May measure their range from the Infernal Bastion. 
 • A maximum of 20 models can shoot from the unit. 
 They can shoot regardless of the rank they are positioned in.

sharedRules.name: Chained Together
sharedRules.description:
The model’s unit may never voluntarily change its number of files.
 After performing a March Move, the unit loses 1D6 HP.

sharedRules.name: Defy Death
sharedRules.description: Melee Attacks against the model can never wound on better than 4+.

sharedRules.name: Theocratic Litigators
sharedRules.description:
The model’s unit, as well as every enemy unit in contact with it, gain Magic Resistance (2), which is also applied to friendly spells. 
This Magic Resistance value cannot be increased.

sharedRules.name: Higher Calibre
sharedRules.description:
The Range of the model’s Shooting Weapon is doubled. 
Enemy units hit by the weapon suffer -1" Charge Speed and -1" Mobility, both to a minimum of 3", with Duration: One Turn.

sharedRules.name: Rock Crusher
sharedRules.description: The Chassis’s Strength is set to 6, and its Armour Penetration is set to 3.

sharedRules.name: Walking Earthquake
sharedRules.description: The models Mobility is set to 7" and it gains Swiftstride,Volcanic Embrace (D3+1).

sharedRules.name: Walking Volcano
sharedRules.description: The model gains Volcanic Embrace (2).

sharedRules.name: Giant See, Giant Do old
sharedRules.description: old definition

sharedRules.name: Giant See, Giant Do
sharedRules.description: The model gains Infernal Armour, Commanding Presence (12, Insignificant), First Strike (Stubborn).

sharedRules.name: Big Brother
sharedRules.description: The model’s HP are set to 9, its base size is changed to 75×100 mm, and the roll for the number of hits with its Stomp Attack is Maximised.

sharedRules.name: Giant Club
sharedRules.description: +1 Str, +1 AP.

sharedRules.name: Tower Shield
sharedRules.description: The model gains +1 Arm, Parry, Hard Target (1).

sharedRules.name: Infernal Lash
sharedRules.description:
+2 Agi. 
Once per Melee Phase, during Combat Choices in a combat within 6" of the wielder, you may activate the following ability:
 Select a single friendly unit within 6" of the wielder (which can be the wielder itself). 
The selected unit gains Flaming Attacks, Magical Attacks. Duration: One Phase.

sharedRules.name: Taurukh Ritual
sharedRules.description:
Apply the following to the model: 
 • It gains Impact Hits (1), Swiftstride, Centauroid, and its Height is set to 2. 
 • Its Charge Speed and Mobility are both set to 7". 
 • Its base size is changed to 25×50mm.

sharedRules.name: Incendiary
sharedRules.description:
Give one Incendiary Marker to the unit, with Duration: Permanent. 
A unit containing one or more Incendiary Markers gains Weakness (Flaming Attacks). 
Remove one Incendiary Marker: 
 • Immediately when the unit suffers one or more wounds (before saves are performed) from Ranged Attacks with Flaming Attacks. 
 • At the end of a Round of Combat in which the unit has suffered one or more wounds (before saves are performed) from Melee Attacks with Flaming Attacks. 
 A Character leaving a unit affected by one or more Incendiary Markers is no longer affected, unless the Character was a single model unit when it gained Incendiary Markers: in that case, the Character keeps those Incendiary Markers.

sharedRules.name: Oil Flasks
sharedRules.description: After resolving all simultaneous attacks, any unit hit by at least one attack with Oil Flasks gains an Incendiary Marker.

sharedRules.name: Volcanic Embrace
sharedRules.description:
The model part gains Grind Attack (X, AP 4, Flaming Attacks, Magical Attacks, Unmodifiable, Zeal (towards Metal Armour)). 
 These hits always wound on a 4+.

sharedRules.name: Infernal Armour
sharedRules.description: The model gains Resistance (Flaming Attacks).

sharedRules.name: Infernal Weapon
sharedRules.description: +1 Str, +1 AP.

sharedRules.name: Airborne Legends
sharedRules.description: All models with Fly share the same Rare models/army restriction.

sharedRules.name: Curse of Nezibkesh
sharedRules.description:
The target gains an Incendiary Marker, and suffers -1 Def and -1 Off. 
In addition, for as long as the target contains an Incendiary Marker it suffers an additional-1 Def and -1 Off.

sharedRules.description: The model cannot choose to Pursue, unless it is its First Round of Combat and it is Charging. In that case, it must Pursue (including Overrun).
